message: The OneDrive workbook and its two structured tables are verified, but the pilot did not establish a managed-app connection. The supported table-binding path returned HTTP403: operation is not on the managed-apps allowlist, at its table-schema metadata step. No measured Excel builds were started.
actionModeEvidence: An earlier claimed action-mode attempt actually used table mode and was retracted. A standalone action-mode command was not executed because support under the connector-specific documented flow was not established. No successful or failed action-mode execution is claimed.
comparisonRule: Pilot and connector-preflight costs are setup, not measured model comparisons. Freeze the successful prompt and review procedure only after a working pilot. Start ten balanced builds, and extend to at most twenty only if the predeclared repeatability gate is met.
